text: It's unbelivable that if I change story I cannot come back and read again the full story I just finished to read. I missed to read one item in "the last cat alive" and now that I changed to another story I need another month of reading something I already know to get that back. Refund me or fix this, and I will give 5 stars.
author: Debora Ravaioli
developer_reply: Hi Assistant to Dr. Wakey, we're sorry for the unpleasant experiences. We have recorded your suggestions and feedback. Thanks again for sharing with us! Please contact our Support Team at Book Morning! → Settings → FAQ & Support → Contact Us if any further assistance is required. Thanks! - Fourdesire Support
